system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Rather than treating model context as a static concatenation of the system prompt and complete interaction history, openJiuwen processes available information according to current context pressure, task state, and content structure.
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt builder not in truncated code evidence; inferred from paper prose on context construction and Rails.

env_context_strategy.note: Instance/task template and tool registry not included in the truncated evidence; paper mentions LSP active queries.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Concrete mechanisms include dialogue summarization, incremental compression of large interaction histories, and full-session compaction.
context_compaction.note: Paper also describes offloading large artifacts and dead-loop collapse; condenser code not in evidence.

observation_format.note: Observation conversion code not in evidence; README mentions image attachments and browser service.

edit_primitive.note: Edit tool definitions not in evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: Schema-producing code not in evidence; MCP configuration documented in README, but hand-written vs auto-generated origin unknown.

protocol_standardization.note: other = E2A (Gateway-AgentServer envelope protocol) and A2UI; documentation-level evidence, line numbers not given.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The Inner Loop follows a bounded ReAct-style interaction.
loop_primitives.note: Default react inner loop plus outer loop; Rails attach to lifecycle hooks (event_driven); Swarmflow deterministic multi-stage workflows (fixed_pipeline) and parallel candidate generation with arbiter (multi_attempt) are config-reachable.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: 任务拆解、规划与执行管理，支持 TodoToolkit 工具进行任务跟踪。

multi_agent_topology.note: Cluster mode: Leader orchestrating multiple specialized agents is the default; Agent mode (single) selectable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The Leader decomposes a complex task and assembles teams, multi agents specialize and negotiate dynamically.
delegation_mechanism.note: Negotiation among teammates may also imply message_bus; mechanism code not in evidence.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: By default, tools ask for approval before they run. If you would rather not confirm every step, adjust the policy in [Tool Permissions & Security]

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The workspace contains runtime data such as todos, sessions, and file storage.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Supports short-term and long-term memory management, automatic post-conversation memory extraction, code-specific memory accumulation, and task experience retrieval, reuse, and continuous accumulation.
long_term_memory.note: Skill Hub / skill self-evolution -> skill_library; task experience store (Self-Reflection) -> episodic_db; file_notes storage form inferred.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Session information management, viewing and restoring historical chats, and deleting session history.

self_verification.evidence_quote: openJiuwen supports self-assessment, independent assessment, and hybrid assessment strategies.
self_verification.note: LSP-driven passive diagnostics injected after code changes (paper Sec. 3.2.4); Goal Mode assessment; defaults unknown.

retry_policy.note: Paper mentions Goal Mode across multiple attempts but no default config in evidence.

rollback.note: Edit tool/undo code not in evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The interaction continues until the model returns an answer, execution is interrupted, or the configured step limit is reached.
termination_condition.note: Team token budget in Swarmflow (README); Goal Mode hard limits on attempts/time/resources.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: supports **HITL** (`human` / `human_session`), **team token budget**, and TUI **`/swarmflows`** run-tree monitoring.
cost_controls.note: KV-cache reuse via session affinity per paper Sec. 3.2.2.

timeouts.evidence_quote: """Resolve the per-round timeout; an omitted/null value means no limit."""
timeouts.note: react.completion_timeout per outer-loop round, off by default; per-tool timeouts not visible in evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: 管理本地 jiuwenbox uvicorn 子进程 — 由 ``/sandbox enable`` 触发启动.
execution_isolation.note: jiuwenbox sandbox is opt-in via /sandbox enable, so default is host execution; sandbox with policy file reachable.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: file access goes through a whitelist

network_policy.note: Network policy config not in evidence (jiuwenbox policy file contents truncated).

permission_model.evidence_quote: By default, tools ask for approval before they run.

tracing.evidence_quote: System log paths, runtime records, and common troubleshooting entry points.
tracing.note: Richer tracing not visible in truncated evidence.
